name: system.apps.installed
description: List installed programs from the Windows Uninstall registry keys (the data behind Programs and Features). Store / MSIX apps, including Windows 11 Notepad, Calculator and Photos, are not listed. Pass `pattern` to filter by name. Read-only.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against `name` (e.g. `chrome` matches `Google Chrome`). Omit to list every entry. No match returns an empty `apps` array.

install_date.description: `InstallDate` value as stored, usually `YYYYMMDD`. Not normalised; installers write it inconsistently.

x-implementations.name: uninstall_keys
x-implementations.description: Read-only walk of the Uninstall subkeys under `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall`, `HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall` and `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall` (`RegOpenKeyEx` / `RegEnumKeyEx` / `RegQueryValueEx`). Entries are skipped when they have no `DisplayName`, when `SystemComponent` is 1, or when `ParentKeyName` is set (patches and updates).

windows-modern.description: All three Uninstall roots. The filter is the subset of Programs and Features filtering the agent applies, not an exact mirror: Programs and Features may also hide some update entries that this list includes. Store / MSIX packages are not in these keys and are not listed.

windows-classic.description: Same walk. Roots that do not exist are skipped: Windows 9x has no `WOW6432Node` and older systems may have no per-user Uninstall key.
